reconciliation.summary: Advance and final releases differ by revision; dataset totals differ by population basis.

security.summary: Threat-suite measurements. They do not guarantee security.

evaluation.summary: Development comparisons A1–A5 and registered held-out H-r3/H-hybrid luna runs. Gold v3.2: 237 development and 31 held-out cases; AI-drafted, not human reviewed.
limitations: Held-out evaluation used unreviewed AI-drafted gold, not human-validated labels.
Paired held-out intervals include zero; retain r3 provisionally, not as a proven winner.
AI judgments are not human review.
Metric definitions differ between evaluation stages.
evaluation.snapshot_policy: Current working-tree metric snapshots; SHA-256 recorded below. The report builder uses committed snapshots only.
evaluation.scoring_deviation: Calculation scorer corrected after held-out execution: signed deterministic record/direction required, free prose and unit wording permitted. All development and registered held-out metrics re-scored; no new generation run.

limitations: Development metrics were refreshed from hash-recorded local files; other measurements retain the original committed snapshot.
The population basis of the dataset employment series is unverified.

provenance.policy: Committed artifacts except evaluation and security metrics explicitly refreshed from SHA-256-identified working-tree snapshots; no model outputs or report passages.

development_refresh.source: Local development metric files; no build or model execution.

security_refresh.source: Final corrected paired r3 threat metric files; no build or model execution.
security_refresh.scope: Security projection only; existing development and held-out evaluation projections preserved.
